quote.quote: These data were presented to the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee, and they voted that asenapine had been shown to be effective for the acute treatment of adult patients with schizophrenia.

summary: The Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee met on 7/30/09 and voted that asenapine (Saphris) had been shown to be effective for the acute treatment of adult schizophrenia and voted overwhelmingly that its effectiveness had been demonstrated for manic/mixed episodes of Bipolar I Disorder; both indications were approved. The only review document describing the committee is the Office Director Decisional Memo, which presents the AC as an efficacy-confirmation meeting (discussion of the marginal schizophrenia efficacy and differential dropouts). The reviews do not explicitly tie any committee-raised concern to a resulting change in the approval (dose restriction to 5-mg bid and the lower-dose/maintenance post-marketing commitments are attributed to the division's own review, not to the AC), so no concern-to-change linkages are recorded.
